answer: Histories are stored in sable, checked in ledge, and reef shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 15 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1282 identities would post 1308 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
